reviewer_ask: 2-3 independent batches or 5-10 biological replicates
what_we_do: Longitudinal perinatal HIV infant cohort from Mozambique; each participant sampled at 2-3 timepoints. Editor allows 'clear exceptions such as case reports'. Cover letter must request this explicitly BEFORE the analysis work is judged.

reviewer_ask: State N and independent experiments in all figure legends
what_we_do: Add n=cells and n=participants to every legend. Table S1 (sample-level) is the backing document.

reviewer_ask: Excel workbook of raw numbers behind every main and supplementary panel
what_we_do: Every revision figure already writes *_source_data.csv. Assemble into one annotated workbook.

reviewer_ask: Representative dot plots, gating strategy, full instrument/antibody details
what_we_do: Gating figures exist (S1B, S4C). Needs instrument, settings, antibody clones, fluorochromes, dilutions, isotype and controls written into Methods.

reviewer_ask: SAGER guidance; disaggregate where collected
what_we_do: Table 1 already has sex per participant. State in Reporting Summary that sex was recorded, self-reported/assigned, and that the cohort is too small for sex-stratified analysis.

reviewer_ask: N=5 longitudinal is small; risk of sampling bias
what_we_do: Cannot add infants retrospectively. Argue cohort rarity (perinatal HIV, Mozambique, pre-ART sampling within weeks of birth). CP018 FACT-Seq adds a second stimulated participant. Add explicit sampling-bias limitation.

reviewer_ask: No analysis of other lineages - 'all sitting there in the dataset'
what_we_do: TARA_ALL_annotated_final.qs2 has 126,435 cells already annotated: CD4 T 56,963, B 17,018, NK 16,146, Mono 5,407, DC 366. Composition by group/timepoint plus DGE per lineage. New main or supplementary figure.

reviewer_ask: Detect HIV-infected (vRNA+) cells via combined human-HIV alignment
what_we_do: GEO download (26 GEX libs) + combined GRCh38+HIV-1 subtype B and C reference + pilot on CP006_1m (VL 10^7, highest in cohort, public series). Three controls: ambient empty-droplet background, CD4 lineage restriction, host transcriptome unchanged. Report whatever it finds with an explicit detection ceiling.

reviewer_ask: Central memory cells not mentioned
what_we_do: Report Tcm frequency from the CD8 object; note infants are naive-dominated. One sentence plus a supplementary panel.

reviewer_ask: Fig 4C: figure shows clusters 0,2,4,6 but legend says 0,1,5
what_we_do: Regenerate panel with cluster NAMES not numbers (house rule) so the mismatch cannot recur.

reviewer_ask: Fig 1E label cropped
what_we_do: Same defect Rev 2 minor 4 reports. Re-render with a wider canvas; run the edge-clipping check.

reviewer_ask: Some CD8 Tn cells cluster with CD4 T cells
what_we_do: Same root cause as Rev 2 major 1d. Show CD8A/CD8B/CD4 RNA and protein per cluster, and whether the population persists in the dedicated CD8 clustering.

reviewer_ask: 'Tpex' not explained
what_we_do: Define at first use, or drop the term. Note: our own CP018 work found no Tpex-consistent population - relabelled to activated stem-like. Check the main manuscript uses the term defensibly.

reviewer_ask: S1A protein scale -1 to 2 too low for DSB normalisation
what_we_do: Confirm whether S1A shows DSB values or a scaled/centred mean. If scaled, say so in Methods. Reviewer expects 5-20 SD above noise for lineage markers.

reviewer_ask: How was Module Score calculated?
what_we_do: Seurat AddModuleScore, control-feature binning, gene lists already in Table 2. Add the method and package version.

reviewer_ask: Total CD8 count; per-participant PBMC and CD8 counts
what_we_do: Table S1 at SAMPLE level (reviewer's own suggestion): PBMC QC-pass, Azimuth CD8, CD8 in dedicated object, TCR-bearing, expanded, QC medians.

reviewer_ask: Fig 1C should be a bubble plot (% expressing + relative expression)
what_we_do: Replace heatmap with dot plot showing pct.exp and avg.exp for RNA and ADT. Directly answers 'is naive 2 really CD8+' by showing CD4 too.

reviewer_ask: Fig 1E shows only TEMRA/CTL by group - show all clusters
what_we_do: Composition of every CD8 cluster by group, as % of total CD8 (see M1e).

reviewer_ask: Rationale for not sub-clustering CD8; does the odd naive 2 persist?
what_we_do: IMPORTANT: the dedicated CD8 re-analysis ALREADY EXISTS - 4.CD8_Subseting.R produces TARA_cd8_HEI_annotated_final.qs2 (18,843 cells, own normalisation/PCA/MNN/WNN, resolutions 0.2-2.0, 10 populations) and backs Figs 4-5. It is simply not shown for Fig 1. Show it, state which figure uses which clustering, and answer the naive-2 question in the dedicated object.

reviewer_ask: Show CD8 cluster frequency as % of total CD8, not % of live cells
what_we_do: Recompute all composition as % of CD8. Correct point - PBMC-denominated frequencies move with other lineages.

reviewer_ask: Fig 2A should show a CD8-only UMAP
what_we_do: Re-render from the dedicated CD8 object.

reviewer_ask: Use frequencies not counts for clonotype dynamics
what_we_do: Convert Fig 2B and 3C to % of CD8 T cells. Correct and cheap.

reviewer_ask: scRepertoire thresholds are proportional - justify absolute counts
what_we_do: State how thresholds were set; recompute cloneSize on proportions of CD8 T cells only.

reviewer_ask: Define 'expanded' clonotype; cite it; acknowledge 2-cell error
what_we_do: Define as >=2 cells with the same CTstrict within a sample, cite, and acknowledge the error at n=2. Our own CP018 work measured this: technical replicates of one draw shared only a small fraction of clonotypes and most clonotypes were singletons.

reviewer_ask: Show the clonotype size distribution; 2-count clonotypes drive results
what_we_do: Histogram of clonotype size per sample, and re-run the cluster-sharing claim restricted to clonotypes >=5 cells to show it is not a 2-cell artefact.

reviewer_ask: P10L282: which expansion definition is used?
what_we_do: State the definition at each use.

reviewer_ask: Database epitope matching unreliable - say 'putative'
what_we_do: Relabel every database-derived call as putative/inferred throughout; cite the preprint the reviewer gives.

reviewer_ask: Known HIV TCRs mis-call as CMV in these databases
what_we_do: Concede directly; it strengthens the case for leaning on FACT-Seq instead.

reviewer_ask: Also acknowledge most TCRs are not public
what_we_do: Add to the same limitation paragraph.

what_we_do: 5.CMV_vs_Expanding_Clones.R and TARA_TRB_ED1_CMVgroup.qs2 already exist. Quantify putative CMV-specific fraction of expanded clonotypes per sample, add to cohort description and discussion.

what_we_do: Dedicated limitations paragraph.

what_we_do: Keep the analysis, remove causal/temporal language. Reframe as ordering by differentiation state, not proof that one state follows another.

what_we_do: Reviewer is right. Rebuild the claim on FACT-Seq only. CP003 has 1,515 and CP018 311 antigen-specific cells from peptide stimulation - far more than the database route. This is also where our CP018 IFN-memory result sits.
